notes.title: 🌍 New Language Update: Korean, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese! ☀️
notes.content:
[b]Hey Puzzlers 👋[/b]

We’ve got some exciting updates for you!

[b]🗣️ River Towns is now available in Korean, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese![/b]
We’re so happy to welcome even more players from around the world to our cozy little towns! 🌏💚

[b]💥 We’ve also hit a few big milestones:[/b]
🔹 Over 2,500 Puzzlers have joined so far
🔹 50+ Steam Reviews
🔹 And we’re officially rated “Very Positive”! 🥳
Thank you for all your amazing feedback and support!

[b]And there’s more:[/b]
🌿 River Towns is part of the Earth Appreciation Festival 2025!
From April 1st to 7th, you can grab the game on sale as part of the festival celebrating our beautiful planet. 🌞

⬇️  Don’t miss out! ⬇️ 
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/earthappreciationfestival2025

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332670/756a0dc1ac7434a66df4c0d42e7a94d4cac8a91e.png[/img]

Thanks so much for your feedback and support. It truly means a lot! 💚
If you’ve played River Towns, feel free to leave us a review on Steam. It helps more than you think!🐸

[u][b]The Frogsong Team 🥰 [/b][/u]

notes.title: 🥳 River Towns has a release date - March 24! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]https://images-ext-1.discordapp.net/external/PaobTrNXuZCmzdcDnjStP5Reyc-HVXpkNvOuFAA08is/https/metaroot.ch/sendy/uploads/1740401512.gif?width=720&height=405[/img]

[b]Hey Puzzler 👋[/b]

Exciting news – our Tetris-like city puzzler, River Towns, is launching on Steam on March 24! We’re super excited to share this milestone with you. Your support has helped us restore the river and bring our dream to life. 🌊 

We’re also joining Steam Next Fest with a brand-new demo featuring a Challenge Level. In the full release, challenge levels will rotate weekly, so you can test your skills over and over again!

[b]Steam Next Fest Challenge Level 🎮[/b]
We've got a special challenge for you for Steam Next Fest! Dive into the demo's Challenge Level and aim for the highest score. The top scorers will win one of 5 Steam Keys for the full version of River Towns. ☺️ Just post a screenshot of your score on our Discord, in the #river-towns-competition channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332670/11fb2f2df6f625c843f802ef48ba87196f7e1d29.gif[/img]

[b]⬇️ If you’d like to support us now and in the future, you can: ⬇️[/b]

[list]
[*] Add River Towns to your Steam Wishlist https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485350/River_Towns/
[*] Tell your favorite content creator about the game
[*] Play the demo during Steam Next Fest and share your feedback on our Discord
[/list]
All of these actions help a lot! 🥰

Thank you for being part of our journey,
[u][b]Frogsong Studios 🐸[/b][/u]

notes.title: 🌊 Welcome to River Towns! 🏡✨
notes.content:
[b]Hey Puzzler👋 [/b]

We’re thrilled to reveal our new game [b]River Towns[/b]—a relaxing yet strategic puzzle experience where you restore a world one vibrant town at a time. 🏘️✨

[h3]We are launching a Kickstarter soon! 🥰 [/h3]

Get ready to be part of something exciting! We’re preparing to launch our Kickstarter campaign soon. To ensure development in the last months before release.
[b]⬇️ Please support us by bookmarking our Kickstarter here ⬇️[/b]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/strayfawnstudio/river-towns?ref=b4ftbn]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/strayfawnstudio/river-towns?ref=b4ftbn[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332670/fdc07b76b24baa426291ecb486e244e17ebd464e.gif[/img]

For you, this means that you can not only support us in our adventure, but also get your hands on "River Towns" in advance at a greatly reduced price! 😄
More about the rewards, our funding goal and more soon.

[h3]Is there a DEMO down the river? 👀 [/h3]
🌟 Find out more on December 10th and keep an eye on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LKIt8AAnqKI]Wholesome Snack[/url]!

In the meantime it would help us a LOT if you could wishlist the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485350/River_Towns/

Cheers,
[u][b]Frogsong Studios🐸 [/b][/u]
